$comment: Drift solve parameters (PLAN.md §4, decision record 0005). unit_cost_km is the cost of crossing one km of each terrain class, in the km-equivalent unit the cell record stores. Maritime civilizations (civs.json) get the maritime multipliers on coast and ocean, landlocked ones the landlocked multipliers; a civilization's own ocean_mul in civs.json multiplies on top (Lapita 0.5, so the Pacific is theirs). Sources start at the layer cost of data/cores (core 0, periphery and corridor as given).
